description: Recurrence rule (RRULE) expander — Expand an RFC 5545 RRULE into concrete dates: FREQ, INTERVAL, COUNT, UNTIL, BYDAY with ordinals (-1FR = last Friday), BYMONTHDAY, BYMONTH, BYSETPOS, BYHOUR, BYMINUTE, WKST, DTSTART;TZID lines. Pass rrule= and start=; optional tz= (IANA, DST-correct UTC times), count= (max 200), after=, exdate=, roll=next|previous to move weekend and US federal holiday dates to a business day. Returns local + UTC times and a plain-English description. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: time_recurrence
